notes.title: DLSS patch
notes.content:
Players who have supported hardware can find now find DLSS options in the Video settings menu. 

A Note on the quality settings:
Quality setting options for DLSS include Auto mode and DLAA, as they are part of the options provided by nvidia. Though neither mode are currently officially supported by the game.  Use of these modes may or may not have an intended affect on quality settings at this time. We recommended selecting an appropriate setting between Ultra Quality and Ultra Performance for the best results.

FSR support will be added in the coming weeks, as soon as the official update is released for unreal 5.3.

tags.feature: Players who have supported hardware can find now find DLSS options in the Video settings menu.

notes.title: Migrated to unreal 5.3
notes.content:
The project is now updated from 5.1 to 5.3.  There were multiple performance upgrades and bug fixes from epic in 5.3. Migrating the project has made optimizing the game a lot easier for us in general and hopefully some users will already experience better performance across the board.  Though this does result in almost a complete reinstall of the game files, we expect to stay on 5.3 for the rest of development, unless undeniable VR performance optimizations are included in future engine versions. So large downloads shouldn't be required again, ahead of new content updates.

[b]VR changes[/b]
- Sweeping optimizations. Most notable is [i]Foveated Rendering[/i] that aims to reduce the GPU overhead by reducing the quality required at the edge of your view. This should result in some notable performance gains without any noticeable degradation in quality.

[b]Desktop Changes [/b]
- Added control option to invert camera pitch (look up and down) by popular request.

[b]Additional optimizations coming soon[/b]
We originally intended to have DLSS shipped at the same time with this patch, but more internal testing is required before we can happily release a build that includes this tech.  On top of this, we're looking at adding similar support for AMD owners so nobody get's left behind! You should hopefully see these graphics options added very soon.

tags.feature: - Added control option to invert camera pitch (look up and down) by popular request.

notes.title: UI Update, Full controller support & more
notes.content:
[h1]Overhauled menus & extended customisation [/h1]
[list]
[*]VR and desktop menu's have been redesigned to fully support a plethora of input devices. 
[*]Automatic input device detection should switch context appropriately in real-time to reflect the device you're currently using (Only in desktop mode)
[*]The full list of scalable graphics options are now exposed under the video menu. Users can now fully customise the graphics options to tweak performance.
[*]Moved the mouse sensitivity option to the Control menu.
[*]Fully customisable key bindings are now exposed in the Control menu (desktop). VR users can use SteamVR's controller bindings menu to rebind keys for Motion Controllers. 
[*]Fixed simulated crouching in VR.
[/list]

notes.title: VR Crash Fix & enhanced input system
notes.content:
[b]VR Mode[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a common issue that would immediately crash the game when loading VR mode. VR mode should now load more reliably. Please continue to feedback any errors you may encounter!
[/list]

[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*] Overhauled the input system, bringing it up to date with the latest solution in engine. 
[*]  Added controller detection for dynamic tooltip feedback based on the controller you are currently using. 
[*] Added support for Windows Mixed Reality controllers.
[*] Enabled engine logging for tracing the cause of crashes, to better enable bug tracking and reporting.
[/list]

notes.title: Bug Fixes & Accessibility
notes.content:
Thank you to our early adopting community for helping us with fantastic feedback and bug fixes from the day 1 client.  This patch is an accumulation of some of the critical issues highlighted by you. 

[h2]VR[/h2]
[list]
[*] A small fix has been implemented to resolve certain startup crashes when launching in VR. 
[/list]

[h2]Standard Mode (Non VR)[/h2]
[list]
[*] Field of View (FOV) option has been added to the video settings. 
[*] Ultra Wide scaling lock option has been added to the video settings for testing.  Users that run displays 16:9 or above can set this option to 'Maintain Y' to cater for Ultra wide displays. Please let us know how this performs for you!
[*] Mouse sensitivity has been corrected and a scale option has been added to the video settings menu.
[*] Added an option to the video settings to toggle Head bob effects.
[/list]

[h2]General[/h2]
[list]
[*]  Any and all motion blur effects have been globally disabled.
[*]  Fixed a bug where users could pick up a second page without dropping the previous, causing the first page to get permanently stuck in their grip. 
[*] Fixed the reach on certain pages that could not be picked up.
[*]  Multiple environmental clipping issues resolved.
[*]  Fixed visual effects quality setting not saving between sessions.
[*]  Graphical and functional updates to the video settings menu.
[*]  The end credits should now not activate too early.
[*]  A data log has been added once the track finishes playing to provide some clarity on the end of the game! No more standing around wondering.
[/list]
